name: Chicken Tenders with Tangy Japanese Tonkatsu Sauce & Nutty Kale Slaw

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 400°F. Coat a baking sheet pan with a thin layer of oil.
Place bread crumbs, oil, salt, and pepper in a small bowl. Stir to combine the breading mixture and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
toasted sesame oil
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Pat chicken dry with paper towels, then slice lengthwise into 1-inch strips. Place in a medium bowl along with mayo, salt, and pepper, then toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
340 g chicken breasts, boneless skinless
1 ½ tbsp mayonnaise
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add breading mixture to the bowl with the chicken and toss to coat, pressing gently to adhere. Transfer chicken to the baking sheet and arrange in a single layer. (Reserve small bowl for later use.)
Place chicken in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway, until golden and cooked through, 18-20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium head napa cabbage
½ bunch kale
½ small bunch green onions (scallions)
1 (1 inch) piece ginger root

instructions.primary_message: Place peanut butter, oil, vinegar, sugar, and spices in a clean medium bowl. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tbsp natural peanut butter
toasted sesame oil
rice vinegar
brown sugar
½ tsp garlic powder
salt
⅛ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, trim off and discard root end of cabbage; halve lengthwise, then slice crosswise into thin (shred-like) strips. Add to the bowl with the dressing.

Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; cut leaves crosswise into thin (shred-like) pieces; add to the bowl. Using your hands, massage kale and cabbage with the dressing until wilted, 1-2 minutes.
Trim and cut green onions crosswise into thin pieces. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop peanuts. Add to the bowl, toss to combine the slaw, and set aside.
Peel and mince ginger. Place in the reserved small bowl, along with ketchup, soy sauce, vinegar, and sugar. Whisk to combine the tonkatsu sauce.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp ketchup
rice vinegar
brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: Divide chicken tenders and slaw between plates. Serve with tonkatsu sauce for dipping and enjoy!
